node.statement: By validated node 1.2, beta lies in C. Node 1.2 proves the needed convex-combination fact: B=sum_j b_j and G=sum_k c_k satisfy B=m+G>0, the coefficients b_j/B are nonnegative and sum to 1, and beta=sum_j (b_j/B) beta_j is a convex combination of points beta_j in C. Since C is convex, beta lies in C, so the beta-in-C premise used by 1.5.2.1 is supplied by this declared validated dependency.
